summary:
Results-driven Technical Leader & Solution Architect with 15+ years of international
experience
designing and delivering highly scalable, secure, and low-latency
systems across banking, payments, trading, and consumer platforms. Expert in cloud-native
architectures, microservices, and mobile-first platforms, with a strong track record
of owning complex system design, solving hard engineering problems, and leading technical
execution end to end. Known for combining deep technical expertise with pragmatic
leadership to deliver systems used by millions of users across multiple countries.
• End-to-End System Design: Ownership of architecture, design decisions, and
implementation across mobile, backend, and cloud platforms.
• Cloud & Distributed Systems: Designed and scaled AWS-based microservices handling
high transaction volumes with strong security and reliability.
• Mobile-at-Scale Architecture: Built mobile platforms with BFF layers, caching, and API
orchestration supporting millions of active users.
• Security & Compliance: Designed and implemented security-sensitive systems including
MFA, encryption, secure fund transfers, and regulatory-compliant workflows
• Performance Engineering: Deep focus on latency, throughput, and reliability;
consistently improved performance and reduced response times
• Technical Mentorship: Acted as technical authority for teams (8–10 engineers), guiding
design, reviewing critical code paths, and enforcing engineering standards
